correctness.rationale: Communicating-class irreducibility follows from a bipartite complement mapping to exclusion at zero hopping and positive-hopping connectivity of even parity. Detailed balance gives the conditional Bernoulli laws. Exact conditional independence reduces mutual information to common count or parity entropy, with correctly normalized finite weights. Local CLT for squared binomial weights gives variance m p(1-p)/2 and entropy (1/2)log(pi e m p(1-p))+o(1). Factorial domination gives the sparse Bessel crossover. Independent enumeration solves 30 complete finite generators and checks asymptotics.

value.rationale: Separating all odd sites from all even sites is dictated by the exact conserved sublattice count in pair adsorption. The resulting information quantity distinguishes an unbounded logarithmic static correlation from a single global parity bit, exhibits a diffusion-induced stationary singularity despite local decorrelation, and has a natural dilute Bessel crossover that sharply delimits the thermodynamic regime. This is meaningful global observable structure rather than a renamed coverage or finite-table value.
